title: Key West Schooner Sunset Sail with Bar & Hors d'oeuvres
includes: Complimentary beer, wine, Champagne and soda
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Must be 21 years or older to consume alcohol.
policies: We recommend bringing a light jacket as it's often cooler on the water.
Meet at Key West Bight Marina 30-45 minutes prior to your selected departure time to check in at ticket booth and board the sailboat for your sunset cruise
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Enjoy an exquisite 2-hour sunset sailing adventure aboard a stunning modern-built schooner! Take in the sights aboard Schooner America 2.0, the most elegant schooner in Key West, as you sail by Mallory Square, Sunset Pier, Sand Key Light Tower and more. Enjoy complimentary beverages throughout your sail along with individually plated hors d'oeuvres. Sit back and relax as your captain sails you effortlessly through the emerald green Key West waters and off toward the horizon for a quintessential Florida sunset experience.
